# Lazarus Deal Recovery

> Lazarus Deal Recovery helps sales managers and VPs of Sales run cleaner forecast calls — which rep-owned deals will close, which stalled deals are recoverable versus a flat no, and what to do in the next 0-90 days. Human-led, AI-assisted. Not an AI SDR or meeting bot.

Lazarus reads a recording, transcript, email thread, and optional HubSpot or Salesforce notes. It names the blocker and returns a CRM-ready brief. Five free analyses; paid plans are priced per deal analysis, not per seat. Keep Meet, Teams, or Zoom — Lazarus never joins the call.

Official site: https://www.getldr.ca/

## Pages

- [Lazarus Deal Recovery](https://www.getldr.ca/): Product homepage — who it is for, how a recovery brief works, objections, and pricing.

- [Terms of Service](https://www.getldr.ca/terms): Customer warranties, acceptable use, and how the service is provided.
- [Data Processing Addendum](https://www.getldr.ca/dpa): Controller/processor roles for B2B use of deal evidence.
- [Security Overview](https://www.getldr.ca/security-overview): Encryption, tenant isolation, subprocessors, and SOC 2 status.
